description.tr: Mutasavvıf, "Âkşehir" şehrinden, Karaman vilâyetinde, Kafkasya bölgesinden "Nahcuvan" ismine nisbete
description.en: Mystic, from "Aqshahr" in the province of "Karaman", attributed to "Nakhchuvān" in the Caucasus regi
